tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Find products by words in their name, slug, tagline or description. Returns the matches with their one-time price. Empty query returns the catalogue.

tools.name: product
tools.description: Everything the product page states about one product, by slug: what it does, what it runs on, its editions and prices, and the cited comparison rows.

tools.name: quickstart
tools.description: The QUICKSTART file that ships inside the product, verbatim — how to install and run it. Returns nothing when that product ships none.

tools.name: checkout_link
tools.description: The buy link for a product, as the Buy button uses. Returns the reason instead when an edition has no checkout configured. It does not buy anything.

tools.name: hosted_offer
tools.description: Which products this store also runs for you, hosted, and at what monthly price. Answers for one slug, or lists every hosted product when no slug is given.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: For one product slug: every cited competitor row its comparison page shows, each with the price as the vendor publishes it, the monthly figure in integer cents where there is one, the vendor page it was read on and the date it was read. Returns an empty list and the reason when the product has no ci

tools.name: guides
tools.description: The published guides. With no slug: the list, newest first, each with its title, description, written date and address, optionally only those whose title, description or slug contain every word of q. With a slug: that guide in full, its body as markdown. A guide that is not published is not found.
